## Purpose

Describe the routine checks and controlled changes needed to keep the REDCap registry usable, consistent and ready for analysis.

## Procedure to complete

1. Review open records, incomplete forms, queries and duplicate warnings at the agreed interval.
2. Review user access and remove or amend access when responsibilities change.
3. Record proposed structural changes before changing fields, forms, branching logic or validation rules.
4. Assess how a proposed change affects existing data, exports and analytical code.
5. Obtain the required approval and test the change away from the live production data where possible.
6. Communicate approved changes to registry and analytical staff.
7. Retain the change record and verify the live database after implementation.

## BNR details to add
